description: 112 controlled single-record updates expanded from 7 RFC boundary templates.

validity_scope.background: All records from the selected Experiment 02 Census case are retained.
validity_scope.control: Shared fixture records are present in both snapshots.
validity_scope.delta: Before and after differ by exactly one ADD, DELETE, or MODIFY.
validity_scope.history: These are controlled interventions, not observed historical Census changes.
